subject.title: Message plugin: support Telegram forum topic management (create/edit/close/reopen)

question: Should permanent Telegram forum-topic deletion require a separate disabled-by-default action permission, while close and reopen follow the ordinary topic-management model?
rationale: Current create/edit actions are enabled by default, so extending that behavior to irreversible deletion changes the authorization and upgrade contract for existing Telegram installations.

options.title: Dedicated deletion opt-in
options.body: Add close and reopen normally, but expose deleteForumTopic only through a distinct disabled-by-default action setting.

options.title: Default-enabled full lifecycle
options.body: Expose close, reopen, and delete using the same default-enabled per-action model as create and edit.

options.title: Reversible lifecycle only
options.body: Add close and reopen but keep permanent topic deletion outside the agent action surface.

recommendation.title: Dedicated deletion opt-in
recommendation.body: Add close and reopen normally, but expose deleteForumTopic only through a distinct disabled-by-default action setting.

likelyOwner.reason: This person merged the original feature and provided the most recent detailed product-routing review for this exact lifecycle request.
